Let me check accessing the admin page after login and also verify the API docs.

One thing: the related links point to `http://api/api/v1/...` which is the internal domain. That might cause issues in the browser but that's how the config was set. Not necessarily a failure.

Let me verify the authenticated admin page renders.

action.command: cd /tmp; echo "=== authenticated admin page ==="; curl -s -b naj.txt -m 30 -o /tmp/admin.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} url=%{url_effective}\n" -L http://localhost:3000/en/admin; grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/admin.html | head; grep -oiE 'logout|dashboard|club' /tmp/admin.html | sort | uniq -c | head; echo "=== openapi spec info ==="; curl -s -m 20 http://localhost:3001/v1_openapi.json | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('title:',d['info']['title']);print('version:',d['info']['version']);print('paths:',len(d.get('paths',{})))" 2>&1
